Subject: Evaluation plan kickoff — SOC 2 evidence & MAP coordination (Redwood <> Nimbus)

Hi Carmen / Aaron —

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood Inference. Per our conversation last week, this thread is to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on roles, evidence needs, and a tight evaluation timeline. Proposed scope: a focused 3-week evaluation covering functionality, performance (latency/cost profiles), and a GRC review for SOC 2 evidence and data handling.

High-level MAP (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): Introductions, agree on POC scope, evidence owner(s), and access requests.
- Week 1: Demo + hands-on evaluation (sandbox access), initial evidence bundle for SOC 2 controls (inventory & controls mapping).
- Week 2: Evidence handoff and validation, one-hour walkthrough of controls, follow-ups on any gaps.
- Goal by EOW Week 3: Decision meeting (produce recommend / go-forward options).

Immediate asks from Nimbus to help us prepare:
1) Primary GRC point of contact for evidence (name + preferred method to receive files).
2) Any non-disclosure or intake process we should be aware of for receiving SOC artifacts.
3) Data handling/PII constraints for the sandbox environment — are there types of production data we should avoid?
4) A short list (one spreadsheet) of the SOC 2 artifacts you expect us to provide — we can pre-populate a template.

We’ve attached a short checklist and our non-prod data flow diagram to show how telemetry & sample data are handled during an eval. Laura (cc'd) will lead evidence collection from Redwood's side; Vivek will own technical/environment setup.

Proposed times for a 30-minute kickoff call: Wed 10/7 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 10/8 11:00–11:30 PT. Let me know what works and who at Nimbus will be the evidence uploader/POC.

Attachments: redwood-nonprod-data-flow.png (diagram), redwood-soc2-evidence-template.csv (template)

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu

Thanks Jasmine — glad to get this moving.

Introducing our GRC lead: Aaron Patel (cc'd). Sagar Iyer (cc'd) will be our procurement/security ops lead and will manage uploads to our evidence portal.

We can work to the 3-week cadence you proposed. A couple of notes from our side:
- We prefer artifacts through Sagar's secure upload. I’ve attached our current evidence inventory (small CSV) — it shows the controls we expect vendors to map.
- For the sandbox, we cannot accept any datasets with PHI/real patient identifiers. Synthetic or masked samples are fine; we also allow telemetry & metrics as long as they are anonymized.
- No additional NDAs required beyond the existing MSA. If you need a POC agreement for temporary access, Sagar will flag it.

Kickoff: Wed 10/7 10:00 PT works for Aaron and me.

Hi Carmen / Aaron —

Thanks for the quick intro and the inventory. I’ve drafted a compact MAP with owners and dates so we have actionable next steps. I’ll post the same doc to the shared drive link Jasmine included. High-level (concrete):

MAP (brief)
- 10/07 — Kickoff call (30m) — confirm scope & access (owner: Jasmine)
- 10/08 — Sandbox credentials issued; initial performance demo (owner: Vivek)
- 10/12 — SOC 2 evidence bundle v1 uploaded by Redwood (owner: Laura) — items: org chart, control matrix mapping, uptime/incident history summary, encryption config, data retention policy excerpts.
- 10/15 — Joint walk-through of evidence; identify any gaps (owner: Aaron / Carmen for Nimbus review)
- 10/19 — Final artifacts & decision readiness call (owner: Jasmine)

Deliverables we will provide by 10/12: pre-populated evidence template (CSV), a short controls narrative for how Redwood handles key CC6/CC7 controls, and a recording of the demo.

We will not put production PHI into the sandbox — we will use anonymized datasets. For clarity on data flow, I’ve attached our non-prod data flow diagram (redwood-nonprod-data-flow.png). Laura will coordinate the actual file uploads to Sagar’s portal (please confirm preferred upload method).

Also, can you confirm whether Nimbus requires any vendor background checks or security questionnaires completed prior to demo access? We can fill those out quickly if so.

Calendar: I’ve tentatively scheduled Wed 10/7 10:00 PT and sent invites; please accept or suggest an alternate.

— Vivek
